# Narrative A — GF / EM identity-lineage task (real replay domain: mafs-v3-p0 Replay B)

## Task origin

This narrative comes from a real operator task in the MAFS v3.0 Replay B benchmark line. The verbatim operator request is:

请调整 MAFS 搜索：von Reyn et al. 2014/2020 等论文补充材料里的 GF 神经元 ID 清单。

requirements.evidence_need: Confirm whether the supplementary-material content of von Reyn et al. 2014 (Nature Neuroscience 17:962-970, DOI 10.1038/nn.3741) contains a modern EM neuron-ID list for the Giant Fiber, and if so which neurons it covers.

epistemic_routes.purpose: Recover the von Reyn 2014 paper identity (DOI/PMID/title) so it can be located and its source content inspected.
epistemic_routes.condition: Paper identity must be recovered by the scholarly stack before source content can be assessed.

epistemic_routes.purpose: Access the von Reyn 2014 full text / supplementary materials to determine whether a GF neuron-ID table exists.
epistemic_routes.condition: Held: the production MAFS v3.0 scholarly stack (Crossref + pubmed_ebsco compiler) does not include a full-text/supplementary-material adapter; the route is only activatable if such an adapter is granted.

source_requirements: von Reyn et al. 2014 supplementary material / full text
requirements.stopping_condition: Stopping condition satisfied when the source-content status is one of: contains a GF neuron-ID table (list coverage), confirmed absent, or SOURCE_CONTENT_NOT_ACCESSIBLE.
requirements.uncertainty_binding: Source content accessibility is unknown; a not-accessible result must be distinguished from a confirmed-absent result.

requirements.evidence_need: Establish whether a 'von Reyn 2020 GF paper' exists in the bibliographic record, or whether the 2020 citation is a conflation with Scheffer et al. 2020 (hemibrain connectome).

epistemic_routes.purpose: Run a bounded negative-branch Crossref search for 'von Reyn' + 2020 + Drosophila / giant fiber and record whether any canonical candidate surfaces.
epistemic_routes.condition: The negative-branch result must be recorded; absence must not be over-claimed as strong non-existence evidence unless positive recall is adequate.

source_requirements: bibliographic record for a von Reyn 2020 GF/EM publication
requirements.stopping_condition: Stopping condition satisfied when the negative-branch status is one of NOT_FOUND_WITH_ADEQUATE_SEARCH, LIKELY_CONFLATION, or COVERAGE_INSUFFICIENT.
requirements.uncertainty_binding: The current scientific reading is 'likely conflation'; the negative-branch search must not fabricate a citation to force a positive result.

requirements.evidence_need: Establish the verified relation GF = Giant Fiber = DNp01 from an authoritative primary source (Namiki et al. 2018 and Virtual Fly Brain FBbt:00004020).

epistemic_routes.purpose: Recover the Namiki et al. 2018 paper and record the DNp01 nomenclature; cross-reference VFB / Monarch records.
epistemic_routes.condition: The nomenclature proposition is recorded; where the production stack does not reproduce the proposition, the status is ORACLE_VERIFIED_BUT_NOT_REPRODUCED_BY_PRODUCTION_STACK.

requirements.stopping_condition: Stopping condition satisfied when the GF == Giant Fiber == DNp01 mapping is verified (or the non-reproduction status is recorded).
requirements.uncertainty_binding: The DNg01 label is a separate open question (CQ-04) and must not be silently folded into this verified mapping.

requirements.evidence_need: Determine whether the historical label DNg01 is the same neuron class as GF / Giant Fiber / DNp01, based on authoritative primary sources.

epistemic_routes.purpose: Look for any authoritative primary source that establishes or refutes a DNg01 == DNp01 synonymy.
epistemic_routes.condition: Absent authoritative evidence of synonymy, DNg01 is treated as a DISTINCT neuron class (UNRESOLVED disposition).

requirements.stopping_condition: Stopping condition satisfied when a DNg01 relation is either established or recorded as UNRESOLVED / DISTINCT_NEURON_CLASS_UNLESS_AUTHORITATIVE_EVIDENCE.
requirements.uncertainty_binding: The question may flip with new primary-source evidence; the current state is UNRESOLVED.

requirements.evidence_need: Resolve the Giant Fiber (DNp01) body root IDs in the FlyWire v783 and hemibrain v1.2.1 datasets.

epistemic_routes.purpose: Query the FlyWire / VFB / hemibrain dataset annotations for the DNp01 left/right body IDs.
epistemic_routes.condition: Held: the production MAFS v3.0 scholarly stack has no FlyWire / VFB / hemibrain dataset adapter. The route is only activatable if a dataset adapter is explicitly granted. Until then the question legitimately terminates as ENTITY_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED.

requirements.stopping_condition: Stopping condition satisfied when the entity IDs are either verified against dataset annotations or recorded as ENTITY_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED (HISTORICAL_ENTITY_ANCHOR_UNVERIFIED).
requirements.uncertainty_binding: The operator-supplied root IDs are unverified against dataset annotations; root IDs may shift across dataset releases (v783 / FAFB14.1 / annotation v2.1.0).
